Title: General availability: Azure Backup Offline backup with Azure Data Box

Body.Content:
Azure Offline Backup using Azure Data Box, a capability that allows you to use Azure Data Box and Azure Data Box disks to seed large initial backups offline to an Azure Recovery Service vault, is now generally available. This simple and secure solution provides you freedom from procuring your own Azure-compatible disks, provisioning temporary storage, or using additional tools to prepare disks and copy data.

Learn more
